# Northern Nevada HOPES

> > Northern Nevada HOPES is a community health center providing integrated medical, legal, and wellness services to underserved populations in Reno and Northern Nevada.

Northern Nevada HOPES operates the Stacie Mathewson Community Wellness Center and partners with Northern Nevada Legal Aid to offer Medical Legal Partnership services. The organization serves patients through comprehensive healthcare, nutrition programs, immunization services, and community outreach events.

## Key Topics

- Community Health Center
- Medical Legal Partnership (MLP)
- Northern Nevada Legal Aid (NNLA)

## Core Programs & Services

- [Medical Legal Partnership](https://www.nnhopes.org/programs/medical-legal-partnership): Medical Legal Partnership with Northern Nevada Legal Aid for patients
- [Stacie Mathewson Community Wellness Center Opening](https://www.nnhopes.org/nnh-blog/hopes-open-the-stacie-mathewson-community-wellness-center-february-1-2016): Stacie Mathewson Community Wellness Center opening announcement
- [Pediatric Nutrition Services](https://www.nnhopes.org/nnh-blog/hopes-nutrition-services-available-to-pediatric-patients): Pediatric nutrition services and 5210 program for childhood obesity
- [Medicaid Expansion Eligibility](https://www.nnhopes.org/nnh-blog/newly-eligible-for-medicaid): Medicaid expansion through Affordable Care Act eligibility info
- [COVID-19 and Flu Vaccines](https://www.nnhopes.org/nnh-blog/vaccines-2023): COVID-19 and flu vaccine availability and immunization services
